scenes.title: the edit form pre-populates Concurrency from a job set to Allow concurrent

steps.caption: Leave the create form, back to the cron list
Move to row 3 — 'Weekly tech-debt sweep', the one demo job set to Allow concurrent
Press [enter] to edit the highlighted job

steps.waitFor: Edit Scheduled Job: Weekly tech-debt sweep
steps.caption: Cron edit form visible, pre-populated (focus starts on Name)
[enter] advances to Agent (the demo daemon reports agent runners, so the Agent select renders)
[enter] advances to Concurrency — the form scrolls to the select

expect.label: focus is on Concurrency (the ┃ focus bar), so the field walk actually reached the select rather than stalling above it
